description: This script is a test suite for verifying the behavior of 'git update-server-info' command. It uses a testing framework with functions like 'test_expect_success' and 'test_tool' to set up test cases, perform operations, and verify outcomes related to Git server info updates.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a series of commands, and verifies successful execution.

methods.name: test_tool chmtime
methods.description: Changes or retrieves the modification time of a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares contents of two files for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the given input is empty.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks if a command returns the expected exit code.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.
